Rashi on Niddah 73a:11:1.hebrew: ואין לי - עושה משכב ומושב בימים שאחר הנדה אלא הרואה שלשה ימים, שני ימים מנין:
Rashi on Niddah 73a:11:1.english: And I have - [Derived that she] transmits impurity to a bed and a seat during the days after the niddah [period] only for one who sees [discharge for] three days; from where [do I derive] two days?

Rashi on Niddah 73a:11:2.english: The verse states - "Every bed which she lies on all the days of her discharge shall be like the bed of her menstruation."

Rashi on Niddah 73a:12:1.english: It shall be for her - [Scripture] added for her a state of being for guarding [a clean day].

Rashi on Niddah 73a:12:2.hebrew: הוא שאינו סופר אחד לאחד - זב בעל ראייה אחת כבעל קרי, וטובל בו ביום, סופר שבעה לשנים:
Rashi on Niddah 73a:12:2.english: He who does not count one for one - A zav who had one sighting is like one who had a seminal emission and immerses on that day, [yet he] counts seven [clean days] for two [sightings].

Rashi on Niddah 73a:13:1.hebrew: אלמא קראי נינהו - כל דין י"א שבין נדה לנדה מכאן למדנו: שהן י"א יום, והרואה בהם ג' הרי זו זבה, והרואה בא', בב' סופרת יום כנגד יום. ולסוף י"א מתחילין ימי נדה: אם תראה אחד תשב ששה והוא, שהרי לא רבינן לדין יום זובה אלא י"א, ומכאן ואילך הרי היא בדין פרשה ראשונה, דכתיב בה שבעת ימים תהיה בנדתה:
Rashi on Niddah 73a:13:1.english: Evidently, they are verses - The entire law of the eleven [days] between [one period of] menstruation and [the next period of] menstruation we have learned from here: that they are eleven days; and that one who sees [blood on] three [days] during them is a [full-fledged] zava; and that one who sees [blood] on one [day or] on two [days] counts day for day; and at the end of the eleven [days], the days of menstruation begin [anew]—if she sees [blood on] one [day], she sits [in impurity for] six [days in addition to] that [day], for we included under the law of the days of her zivah only eleven [days], and from here on she is under the law of the first section [concerning menstruation], regarding which it is written: "Seven days she shall be in her menstruation" (Leviticus 15:19).

Rashi on Niddah 73a:13:2.hebrew: לרבי עקיבא קראי - דלא גמר הך הלכתא הלכה למשה מסיני דקאמר ר' אלעזר בן עזריה, וכי היכי דיליף חצי לוג שמן לתודה מקראי, הכי נמי יליף אחד עשר יום שבין נדה לנדה מקראי:
Rashi on Niddah 73a:13:2.english: According to Rabbi Akiva, [they are derived from] verses - For he did not learn this rule [as] a halakha transmitted to Moses from Sinai, which Rabbi Elazar ben Azarya stated; and just as he derives a half-log of oil for the thanks offering from verses, so too he derives the eleven days between [one period of] menstruation and [the next] from verses.

Rashi on Niddah 73a:14:1.hebrew: ביממי - ראתה ביום תהיה זבה, כדכתיב (ויקרא טו) ימים רבים, אבל ראתה בלילות לא תהא זבה:
Rashi on Niddah 73a:14:1.english: During the day - If she saw [blood] during the day, she shall be a zava, as it is written (Leviticus 15): "many days", but if she saw [blood] at night, she shall not be a zava.

Rashi on Niddah 73a:14:2.hebrew: סמוך לנדתה - ליל שמיני, שהרי ימי נדות כל שבעה עד הלילה, כדכתיב: שבעת ימים תהיה בנדתה:
Rashi on Niddah 73a:14:2.english: Close to her menstruation - The eighth night, for the days of menstruation are all seven [days] until nightfall, as it is written: "Seven days she shall be in her menstruation."

Rashi on Niddah 73a:15:1.hebrew: הלכות - משנה וברייתא, הלכה למשה מסיני:
Rashi on Niddah 73a:15:1.english: Halakhot - Mishnah and Baraita, [and] a halakhah transmitted to Moses from Sinai.

Rashi on Niddah 73a:1:1.hebrew: בלא עת נדתה - אינו אומר לך אלא ברואה שלשה אחר ימי נדתה, סמוך לנדתה, שראתה יום ראשון אחר ז' ימי נדתה, וראתה שמיני ותשיעי ועשירי:
Rashi on Niddah 73a:1:1.english: Not in the time of her menstruation - It tells you only of [a woman] who sees [discharge on] three [days] after the days of her menstruation, adjacent to her menstruation: that she saw on the first day after the seven days of her menstruation, and saw [on the] eighth, ninth, and tenth [days].

Rashi on Niddah 73a:2:1.english: Or if she has a discharge - To include [a woman] who sees [blood on the] ninth, tenth, and eleventh [days].

Rashi on Niddah 73a:3:1.english: From where [is it derived] to include two, three, etc. - For they all have the same law.

Rashi on Niddah 73a:4:1.english: You say: Just as we find on the fourth - Of the days following niddah.

Rashi on Niddah 73a:4:2.hebrew: שהוא ראוי - לספירת נקיים, אם ראתה אב"ג ופסקה:
Rashi on Niddah 73a:4:2.english: That it is fit - For the counting of clean [days], if she saw [blood on days] 1, 2, [and] 3, and ceased [bleeding].

Rashi on Niddah 73a:4:3.hebrew: וראוי לזיבה - לצרף עם בג"ד, אם לא ראתה בא', דהא אתרבי מופלג יום אחד מקרא ד"או כי תזוב", דהיינו בג"ד. אף אני מרבה כל אלו עד י', ויו"ד בכלל, שהן ראויין לספירה אם ראתה שלשה ראשונים, משכי ז' נקיים, עד שיהו נמי נראין לזיבה באיזה מהם שתראה שלשה רצופין:
Rashi on Niddah 73a:4:3.english: And fit for ziva - To combine with [days] two, three, and four, if she did not see on [day] one; for [bleeding] separated by one day was included from the verse "or if she has a discharge", which is [days] two, three, and four. So too I include all these [days] up to [day] ten, and [day] ten is included, as they are fit for counting if she saw [bleeding on] the first three [days]—the span of seven clean [days]—so that they should also be fit for ziva, in whichever of them she sees three consecutive [days].

Rashi on Niddah 73a:5:1.hebrew: מנין לרבות י"א - שיצטרף עם הראשונים לזיבה לג' רצופין, ואע"ג שאינו ראוי לספירת נקיים של זיבת ג' ראשונים:
Rashi on Niddah 73a:5:1.english: From where [is it derived] to include the eleventh [day] - That it should combine with the earlier [days] for ziva for three consecutive [days], even though it is not fit for the counting of clean [days] of the ziva of the first three [days].

Rashi on Niddah 73a:5:2.english: The verse states: "Not in the time of her menstruation" - And even [if it is] separated by many days.

Rashi on Niddah 73a:5:3.hebrew: יכול - כיון דכתיב בלא עת נדתה, שאני מרבה אף י"ב, שאם ראתה י', י"א, י"ב תהא זבה גמורה, ולא תהא תחלת נדה בראיית י"ב, אלא מצטרף לזיבה:
Rashi on Niddah 73a:5:3.english: One might have thought - Since it is written, "not in the time of her menstruation," that I should include even the twelfth [day] — such that if she had a discharge on the tenth, eleventh, and twelfth [days], she would be a full zava, and the discharge on the twelfth [day] would not be the beginning of niddah, but rather it would combine toward zivah.

Rashi on Niddah 73a:6:1.hebrew: יום י"א שהוא ראוי לספירת זיבה או כי תזוב - דזיבה רביעי מתרבי מאו כי תזוב, ולאותה זיבה משכי ימי ספירה עד י"א:
Rashi on Niddah 73a:6:1.english: The eleventh day, which is fit for the counting of the ziva of "or if she has a discharge" - For the ziva of the fourth [day] is derived from "or if she has a discharge," and for that ziva, the days of counting extend until the eleventh [day].

Rashi on Niddah 73a:7:1.hebrew: ואין לי - שתקרא זבה לטומאה, אלא רואה שלשה רצופין:
Rashi on Niddah 73a:7:1.english: And I have no [source] - That she is called a *zavah* regarding ritual impurity, except [one who] sees [discharge on] three consecutive [days].

Rashi on Niddah 73a:7:2.english: The verse states: "Days of" - [In the verse:] "All the days of the issue of her impurity she shall be as the days of her menstruation."

Rashi on Niddah 73a:8:1.english: "Impure" teaches that she renders one who has intercourse with her impure like a menstruating woman - For regarding her [the menstruating woman], it is explicitly stated: "...a man who lies [with her]..." etc.

Rashi on Niddah 73a:9:1.hebrew: היא שאינה מטמאה - בשלש ראיות ביום אחד טומאת זוב גמור לקרבן, כאילו ראתה שלשה ימים. אבל זב מטמא בין בג' ראיות ביום אחד, בין בג' ימים רצופין, בב"ק בפ' כיצד הרגל (דף כד.):
Rashi on Niddah 73a:9:1.english: She who does not become impure - [That is, she does not become impure] through three sightings on a single day with the impurity of full zivah regarding an offering, as if she had seen [blood on] three days. But a zav becomes impure, whether through three sightings on a single day or through three consecutive days, [as stated] in Bava Kamma, in the chapter "Keitzad HaRegel" (page 24a).

Tosafot on Niddah 73a:11:1.hebrew: ת"ל כל ימי נדתה - תימה, דהך מוקמינן כר"ע, אלמא ר"ע קא דריש כל; וכן בשלהי פ' התערובת (זבחים פב.) דריש ר"ע כל. וא"כ, כי קאמר בפסחים פרק אלו עוברין (פסחים דף מג:): "מאן שמעת ליה דדריש כל? ר' אליעזר הוא", דלמא ר"ע הוא, דדריש נמי כל? ויש לומר, דאין לדמות דרשות דכל להדדי, דיש כל דשייך למדרש לכ"ע; והאי דשמעתין דלמנינא מדרש שפיר, דמדימי למנינא, כל נמי למנינא:
Tosafot on Niddah 73a:11:1.english: The verse states: "All the days of her menstruation" - [This is] puzzling, as we establish this [baraita] in accordance with Rabbi Akiva, which implies that Rabbi Akiva expounds [the word] "all" (kol); and likewise at the end of the chapter [entitled] "HaTa'arovet" (Zevachim 82a), Rabbi Akiva expounds [the word] "all" (kol). And if so, when [the Gemara] says in Pesachim, in the chapter [entitled] "Ellu Overin" (Pesachim 43b): "Whom did you hear who expounds [the word] 'all' (kol)? It is Rabbi Eliezer" — perhaps it is Rabbi Akiva, who also expounds [the word] 'all' (kol)? And one can say that one should not compare derivations of [the word] "all" (kol) to one another, for there is [a use of the word] "all" (kol) that is suitable to be expounded according to everyone; and this [derivation] in our sugya, which is for counting [days], is well expounded, for since [the word] "days" (yemei) is [expounded] for counting, "all" (kol) is also [expounded] for counting.

Tosafot on Niddah 73a:15:1.hebrew: תנא דבי אליהו כל השונה הלכות - אית ספרים דלא גרסינן ליה, מיהו בפירוש רש"י איתא, ור"ת הגיהו בספרו. וכן נראה, דאיידי דאיירי לעיל בהלכתא, מייתי לה לסיים בדבר טוב. ואיתא נמי כן במגילה פרק בתרא (דף כח:); והכי נמי אמרינן באין עומדין (ברכות לא.), שכן מצינו בנביאים הראשונים שסיימו דבריהן בדברי שבח ותנחומין:
Tosafot on Niddah 73a:15:1.english: The school of Eliyahu taught: Whoever studies halakhot - There are books in which we do not have this reading; however, it is present in Rashi's commentary, and Rabbeinu Tam emended [it into] his book. And so it appears [correct], for since [the Gemara] was dealing above with halakhah, it brings this [teaching] in order to conclude with a positive matter. And it is also [found] like this in Megillah, the last chapter (28b); and so too we say in [the chapter of] "Ein Omedin" (Berakhot 31a), for so we find with the early prophets, who concluded their words with words of praise and consolation.

Tosafot on Niddah 73a:3:1.hebrew: אין לי אלא יום אחד מנין לרבות מופלג שנים ושלשה - אגב ריהטא נקט שנים, דשנים היינו יום שני לימי זיבה, דהיינו מופלג יום אחד שריבה כבר; דהא מני ואזיל עד י' וי"א, וא"כ שנים היינו שני:
Tosafot on Niddah 73a:3:1.english: I have [derived] only one day; from where [is it derived] to include [a sighting] separated [by] two and three - In the flow of speech, [the Tanna] mentioned "two," for "two" is the second day of the days of zivah, which is [the case of being] separated by one day that was already included; for [the baraita] continues counting up to ten and eleven, and if so, "two" means "second."

Tosafot on Niddah 73a:9:1.hebrew: הוא שמטמא בראיות כבימים אינו דין כו' - תימה, דאיכא למפרך: מה להיא, שכן מטמאה באונס! והכי אמרינן בריש פרק בנות כותים (לעיל נדה לב:) דלא ילפינן מהדדי. וכן לקמן, דקאמר מה הוא שאינו סופר אחד לאחד כו', איכא למפרך: מה להוא, שכן מטמא בראיות כבימים! מיהו בזה מצינן שפיר למילף, דלגבי ספירה אחמיר רחמנא באשה מבאיש, ולענין ספירה עביד שפיר ק"ו, הואיל ולענין ספירה מצינו שהחמיר באשה מבאיש. וצ"ל שאינו קל וחומר גמור, אלא כמו גילוי מילתא בעלמא לגלות זה על זה. וצ"ע, דאיכא מקומות דאיכא תרי קראי לדם נדות ולזיבות, ויש מקומות דנפקא מחד קרא:
Tosafot on Niddah 73a:9:1.english: He, who becomes impure through sightings like [through] days, is it not logical, etc. - [This is] astonishing, for one can refute [this inference]: What [is unique] to her? That she becomes impure [even] through circumstances beyond her control (ones)! And so we say at the beginning of the chapter [entitled] Benot Kutim (above, Niddah 32b), that we do not derive them from one another. And similarly later on, where [the Gemara] says, "Just as he, who does not count one [clean day] for one [day of discharge], etc.," one can refute: What [is unique] to him? That he becomes impure through sightings like [through] days! However, in this [latter case], we can indeed properly derive it: for regarding counting, the Merciful One was more stringent with a woman than with a man, and regarding counting, one properly makes an a fortiori inference (kal va-chomer), since regarding counting we find that [the Torah] was more stringent with a woman than with a man. And it must be said that [the inference here] is not a complete a fortiori inference, but rather like a mere clarification (giluy milta be-alma), to reveal [the rule of] one from the other. And [this matter] requires further study, for there are places where there are two verses, for menstrual blood (dam niddut) and for zivah, and there are places where it is derived from a single verse.
